goalSummary: The smoke test exits cleanly with code 0, yet the subsequent full run indexes only a small fraction of expected data after many minutes.

facts.why: Runbook must reference the directory holding per-index state indicator files
Primary post-mortem artifact for smoke test failures must be named
Cause: DB rollback masks the root error, producing a misleading clean exit code
Confirmation baseline timing for a healthy cold build must be stated
